description: Create a new test case for a use case. Anything the test must or must not touch, including which target and which path, goes in the test case's stored description before the run. A limit stated only in chat with the coding agent does not reach the run. Optionally place it on the project's test states: the roles it acts as (actsAsRoleIds), the state it needs to start (prerequisiteStateId) and the state it leaves when it passes (resultStateId), using ids from muggle-remote-test-chaining-catalog-get.

actsAsRoleIds.description: Test role IDs (UUID) the test acts as, in order; null clears them

alwaysStartsFreshSession.description: True when the test must begin in a brand-new browser session with nothing signed in: its precondition needs a signed-out visitor, a brand-new account, or the first registration or sign-in of an account. False when it continues in a state an earlier test established, such as already being signed in or data an earlier test created.

automated.description: Whether this test case is automated (default: true)

description.description: Detailed description of what the test case validates. Anything the test must or must not touch, including which target and which path, goes in the test case's stored description before the run. A limit stated only in chat with the coding agent does not reach the run.

goal.description: Concise, measurable goal of the test

pinnedAccount.description: Project secrets the test case signs in as. Omit to leave it unpinned

emailSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account email

passwordSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account password

precondition.description: Initial state/setup required before test execution

prerequisiteStateId.description: Test state ID (UUID) the test needs to start; null clears it

resultStateId.description: Test state ID (UUID) the test leaves when it passes; the prerequisite's ID for an observation; null clears it

url.description: Target URL for the test case

useCaseId.description: Use case ID (UUID) to associate the test case with

name: muggle-remote-test-case-create
